title: Apocalypse Clock: Global Systemic Risk Monitor
description: Apocalypse Clock is an experimental, browser-based systemic-risk dashboard covering 59 modeled risk elements: 23 interacting headline threats and 36 nested Climate Breakdown and Ocean Degradation subsystem components. It combines scenario controls, Monte Carlo uncertainty sampling, dependency-aware aggregation, Weibull horizon diagnostics, network analysis, and exportable model outputs. The project is not peer reviewed. Model outputs are scenario outputs, not predictions.
notes: Version 1.3 uses dataset v1.9.1 dated 2026-09-23, with 23 headline threats and 36 nested climate and ocean subsystem components. The model does not claim empirical calibration or predictive validation. The project is not peer reviewed and outputs remain conditional scenarios, not predictions.
